descriptionChirho: A proper gentilicic noun referring originally to the inhabitants of Kition on Cyprus, extended in prophetic and apocalyptic literature to denote western maritime peoples (especially in Daniel and the Dead Sea Scrolls); transliterated as Quitim/Kitim (Spa), कित्तीम (Hin), كِتِّيم (Arb), 깃딤/깃딬 (Kor), Kitimu (Swa). The English gloss 'to Cyprus' in S107942 shows the geographic reference, while the ketiv variant in S107943 is a scribal orthographic difference, not a semantic distinction. All three clusters denote the same referent across bare, prepositional, and ketiv/qere forms.
